videos.description:

Billions of dollars in contracts changed hands in the 15 minutes before the announcement. videos.title: How Cheap Mortgages Are Backfiring On Homeowners
videos.description:
Many Americans took advantage of historically low mortgage rates during the pandemic. But for homeowners who opted for adjustable-rate mortgages, those savings might not last. As mortgage rates continue to remain elevated, hundreds of thousands of borrowers are soon nearing the end of their introductory fixed-rate periods, putting them at risk of higher monthly payments. And with refinancing no longer offering the same relief it once did, some homeowners could find themselves facing a difficult financial decision.

videos.title: Financiación de las mipymes: Uso de datos para el empleo | Reuniones Anuales de 2026
videos.description:
Las pequeñas empresas crean empleo en las economías en desarrollo. ¿Cómo pueden los datos ayudarlas a obtener el financiamiento que necesitan para crecer?

Sigue «Financiación de las mipymes: Uso de datos para el empleo» en vivo desde las Reuniones Anuales de 2026 en Bangkok. Ajay Banga, presidente del Grupo Banco Mundial, conversará con representantes del sector empresarial y financiero sobre cómo las tecnologías digitales y los datos pueden ayudar a las micro, pequeñas y medianas empresas (mipymes) a ganar visibilidad, acceder a los mercados y obtener financiamiento.

Las mipymes representan 9 de cada 10 empresas y emplean a tres cuartas partes de los trabajadores en las economías en desarrollo. Impulsar su crecimiento será fundamental a medida que más personas se incorporen al mercado laboral.

Las Reuniones Anuales de 2026 reúnen a líderes de todo el mundo en Bangkok, del 12 al 18 de octubre, para debatir sobre empleo, inversión, crecimiento y soluciones prácticas para el desarrollo.

📅 Sigue la transmisión en vivo el 13 de octubre. Envía tus preguntas en el chat y consulta la página del evento: https://envivo.bancomundial.org/es/evento/2026/reuniones-anuales-financiamiento-pequenas-medianas-empresas?cid=ECR_YT_Worldbank_ES_EXT

¿Qué ayudaría más a las pequeñas empresas a crecer y crear empleo: financiamiento, datos y tecnología, regulaciones más favorables o acceso a los mercados? Comparte tu opinión en los comentarios.

videos.title: Financement des MPME : mettre les données au service de l’emploi | Assemblées annuelles 2026
videos.description:
Les petites entreprises créent des emplois dans les économies en développement. Comment les données peuvent-elles les aider à obtenir les financements nécessaires à leur croissance ?

Suivez « Financement des MPME : mettre les données au service de l’emploi » en direct des Assemblées annuelles 2026 à Bangkok. Ajay Banga, président du Groupe de la Banque mondiale, échangera avec des acteurs économiques et financiers sur la manière dont les technologies numériques et les données peuvent aider les micro, petites et moyennes entreprises (MPME) à gagner en visibilité, à accéder aux marchés et à obtenir des financements.

تخلق المنشآت الصغيرة فرص عمل في الاقتصادات النامية. فكيف يمكن للبيانات أن تساعدها في الحصول على التمويل اللازم للنمو؟

videos.description:
How can developing countries harness AI to create jobs, improve services, and expand economic opportunities? videos.description:

videos.title: Why This Deep Red State Is a Battleground for the GOP’s Future | WSJ
videos.description:
Idaho, deeply Republican and mostly rural, is about the furthest you could get from a battleground state. So it is no surprise it is often overlooked in the national media during midterm elections.

But under the surface there is a groundswell of tensions between traditional Republicans, the MAGA loyalists and newer hardline-right politicians tussling for power and influence in Idaho. This Mountain West state has become a key bellwether for the fight over what a post-Trump Republican Party could become at the national level, as well as a test lab for some of the nation’s most controversial conservative legislation.

WSJ’s Robbie Gramer returns to his home state of Idaho to explore what the tensions between Idaho’s traditional Republicans and a newer, hard-line political right could mean for the Republican party’s national identity ahead of the midterms.

videos.title: Why the Kushner-Trump $1.4B Albania Resort Is in Trouble | WSJ
videos.description:
ZVERNEC, ALBANIA – On the doorstep of a Jared Kushner-linked development site, a group of determined villagers set out in late May to protest barbed-wire fencing preventing their access to a coastal peninsula. 

A video of the scene captured security guards punching one resident in the throat and dragging him along the beach by his arms. The incident sparked outrage and inspired a nationwide protest movement dubbed the “Flamingo Revolution,” with demonstrators calling for an end to the plans for a luxury resort and for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama. 

WSJ analyzes Albanian court documents, travels to the development areas, and speaks to the villagers at the heart of disputes over land ownership.

videos.title: Inside Man: How Chinese Spies Used Lies, Romance And Betrayal To Target The Federal Reserve
videos.description:
One week after a friendly summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Donald Trump, CNBC details an aggressive plot by China to infiltrate one of the United States’ most important institutions: the Federal Reserve. This explosive documentary delves into the incredible saga of a Chinese spy's effort to obtain secrets from the inner confines of the U.S.' top bank. It's a tale of sex, money, deceit and betrayal that put some of the country’s vital economic and financial secrets at risk. With exclusive access to new documents, audio, photos and text messages, CNBC's Senior Washington Correspondent Eamon Javers uncovers the story of former Fed economist John Rogers and a Chinese spy posing as an economics student who he befriended in 2013. “Inside Man” is a spy story at the heart of the competition for global economic dominance, posing the question of whether Rogers was a spy himself or an unwitting dupe.

videos.title: Why Diamond Prices Are Falling So Fast
videos.description:
Natural diamond prices have plummeted roughly 60% since 2022 as lab-grown alternatives take over the engagement ring market. Reporter Liz Napolitano takes a look inside the factory-made diamond boom, the crisis facing mining giants like De Beers, and whether mined stones are finally hitting rock bottom.
